# LOG-004: A metrics agent is present

- **Group:** Logs and monitoring
- **Severity when it fails:** info
- **Root:** not needed

## Why it matters

Without metrics and an alert for disk and SSH logins you find out about problems from users. Informational. Looked for: agent files and units on the host (node exporter, Alloy, Grafana Agent, Netdata, Telegraf, Zabbix, Datadog, Beszel), running containers by image (grafana/alloy, prom/node-exporter, netdata/netdata, grafana/agent, grafana/promtail, datadog/agent, newrelic/infrastructure, telegraf, timberio/vector, fluent/fluent-bit, zabbix agents, cadvisor, beszel-agent), and processes that own a listening socket. Agents on another host or in a PaaS are not detected.

## Verify by hand

```sh
systemctl list-units '*exporter*' '*netdata*' '*alloy*'; docker ps --format '{{.Image}}'
```

## How to fix it

Add monitoring with an alert for disk usage and SSH logins.

Run `stackward explain LOG-004` for the same text in your terminal. [All checks](index.md).
